value.answer: Sorry you're looking for that. In Toronto, Psychotherapy Referral Service can connect you with registered psychotherapists, and First Session lists Toronto therapists and does free consultations. If you have an extended health plan through work, it may cover a private therapist, and your employer's Employee Assistance Program may include a few free sessions. If money is tight, Family Service Toronto has sliding-scale fees based on income, and the Ontario Structured Psychotherapy program is free for adults with depression or anxiety. If things get urgent, call 911 or ConnexOntario at 1-866-531-2600, open 24 hours.
